# Baiden Creatives

> Baiden Creatives is a creative and technology company from Accra, Ghana, working with companies, startups and founders internationally. It designs and builds websites, web platforms, digital products, brand identities, graphics and motion work. Statement: "Built from imagination. Made for impact." It also creates its own products, including BAID X.

Founders: Baiden David and Baiden Daniel (co-founders).
Website: https://www.baidencreatives.org/
Email: edstudios77@gmail.com
Phone / WhatsApp: +233 55 836 2423
Social: @baidencreatives on Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/baidencreatives), TikTok (https://www.tiktok.com/@baidencreatives) and X (https://x.com/baidencreatives).
Based in: Accra, Ghana. Works remotely with clients anywhere. Language: English.

## Original product: BAID X
BAID X is an original product by Baiden Creatives: "Ghana's work network". It connects workers, companies, project managers, suppliers and clients across all 16 regions of Ghana. People are verified by a person at BAID X, and job payments are held in escrow until the client approves the work. The BAID X mobile app is in development and not yet released. Live product: https://www.baid-x.com
